title: Cigar-shaped craft near Turtle Mountain
summary: Christa tells of Cigar-shaped craft near Turtle Mountain, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Turtle Mountain, on the road from Cuba, New Mexico

tellings.quote: but there was this, it looked like a cigar.

plain: A woman named Christa says she saw a craft shaped like a cigar near Turtle Mountain, on the road from the town of Cuba, New Mexico. She tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast and mentions a United Airlines pilot in connection with the sighting. If true, it would be one more sighting of an unknown craft over the New Mexico desert.
